title_en: Jobs (17/20): A Day at the Vet's
note_en: 起来 after an adjective or verb marks the start of a new state: 又变得活泼起来 "became lively again," literally "started getting lively." Where 了 simply says a change has happened, 起来 stresses that the change is getting under way, much like English "start to" or "get" (热起来 "it's getting hot").
